cues: This is the classic example of magical realism: impossible events told in exactly the same calm tone as ordinary ones, so the magic feels like part of everyday life.
The narrator never explains it, and the characters soon find it a nuisance rather than a marvel.
An angel arrives, and he smells of the outdoors and is fed eggplant mush.
